SELECT p.id,
    p.name,
    COALESCE(sum(rp.score), (0)::bigint) AS score,
    COALESCE(sum(rp.matches_picked), (0)::bigint) AS total_matches,
    count(rp.round_id) AS rounds_played,
        CASE
            WHEN (count(rp.round_id) > 0) THEN round(((sum(rp.score))::numeric / (count(rp.round_id))::numeric), 2)
            ELSE (0)::numeric
        END AS avg_score_per_round
   FROM (players p
     LEFT JOIN round_players rp ON ((rp.player_id = p.id)))
  GROUP BY p.id, p.name;

WITH stats AS (
         SELECT r.season_id,
            rp.player_id,
            COALESCE(sum(rp.score), (0)::bigint) AS score,
            COALESCE(sum(rp.matches_picked), (0)::bigint) AS total_matches,
            count(rp.round_id) AS rounds_played
           FROM (round_players rp
             JOIN rounds r ON ((r.id = rp.round_id)))
          GROUP BY r.season_id, rp.player_id
        )
 SELECT s.id AS season_id,
    s.name AS season_name,
    s.start_year,
    s.end_year,
    s.is_current,
    p.id,
    p.name,
    COALESCE(st.score, (0)::bigint) AS score,
    COALESCE(st.total_matches, (0)::bigint) AS total_matches,
    COALESCE(st.rounds_played, (0)::bigint) AS rounds_played,
        CASE
            WHEN (COALESCE(st.rounds_played, (0)::bigint) = 0) THEN (0)::numeric
            ELSE round(((st.score)::numeric / (st.rounds_played)::numeric), 2)
        END AS avg_score_per_round
   FROM ((seasons s
     CROSS JOIN players p)
     LEFT JOIN stats st ON (((st.season_id = s.id) AND (st.player_id = p.id))));

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.profiles p
    where p.id = auth.uid()
      and p.role = 'admin'
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.lock_in_picks_block_match(p_draw_number bigint, p_user_id uuid, p_picks jsonb)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
declare
  v_taken_count int;
begin
  -- p_picks förväntas vara en json-array:
  -- [{ "event_number": 1, "pick": "1X" }, ...]
  -- 1) Kolla konflikter: matchen finns redan för annan user?
  select count(*)
  into v_taken_count
  from public.stryktipset_picks sp
  join jsonb_array_elements(p_picks) j on (sp.event_number = (j->>'event_number')::int)
  where sp.draw_number = p_draw_number
    and sp.user_id <> p_user_id;

  if v_taken_count > 0 then
    raise exception 'One or more matches are already taken';
  end if;

  -- 2) Upsert dina picks
  insert into public.stryktipset_picks (draw_number, event_number, user_id, pick, updated_at)
  select
    p_draw_number,
    (j->>'event_number')::int,
    p_user_id,
    (j->>'pick')::text,
    now()
  from jsonb_array_elements(p_picks) j
  on conflict (draw_number, event_number) do update
  set
    user_id = excluded.user_id,
    pick = excluded.pick,
    updated_at = excluded.updated_at;

  -- 3) Ta bort allt annat du tidigare hade i samma draw
  delete from public.stryktipset_picks
  where draw_number = p_draw_number
    and user_id = p_user_id
    and event_number not in (
      select (j->>'event_number')::int from jsonb_array_elements(p_picks) j
    );
end;
$function$
functions.identity_arguments: p_draw_number bigint, p_user_id uuid, p_picks jsonb

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.recompute_round_total()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
begin
  update rounds r
    set totalScore = coalesce((select sum(score) from round_players rp where rp.round_id = r.id), 0)
    where r.id = coalesce(NEW.round_id, OLD.round_id);
  return null;
end $function$
